conditions.content: Project P-EXAMPLE with three stored templates, one missing recipient address, and a 14-item attachment list
conditions.notes: Same seeded database both sides; same operator account; fonts installed.

structural_changes.change: Configuration forms replaced by a review of populated values with only missing or variable choices editable

improvements.claim: Repeated entry of the recipient block removed
improvements.evidence_before: before/observations.json step 4: recipient typed although present on the project
improvements.evidence_after: after/observations.json step 2: recipient shown populated, editable

improvements.claim: Readiness visible before generation instead of after a failed job

findings_disposition.note: Batch path for expert operators designed, not built in this cycle.

assumptions: Operators prepare packages a few times a week; the guided sequence is the default and the batch path is secondary.
